【原视频简介】
What if you could build a complete project with AI without installing a single thing?

In this video, I test MonkeyCode, an open-source AI development platform that runs directly in your browser. It provides a cloud development environment where AI can write code, install dependencies, build, test, and preview your project.

I’ll build a real project from scratch and see how well MonkeyCode handles the entire development workflow.
